text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, fondaparinux sodium is not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 70 syringes (6.6 days on hand at 10.6 per day). Corvale General holds 327 syringes (30.6 days on hand at 10.7 per day). Corvale Lakeside holds 27 syringes (15.9 days on hand).

Why (FDA record): FDA's most recent inspection of Italfarmaco S.p.A. (FEI 1196) ended 2023-06-28 and was classified VAI. FDA's most recent inspection of ScinoPharm Taiwan, Ltd. (FEI 3002840477) ended 2026-06-23 and was classified OAI with seven observations including procedures for sterile drug products and validation lacking for sterile drug products.

Our position: Supply at Corvale East is below target. Corvale General has sufficient stock to support a transfer. Alternate manufacturers Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited, Eugia US LLC, Mylan Institutional LLC, and Sandoz Inc. are not on FDA's shortage list, but their labels name no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 79 syringes of 7.5 mg/0.6 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — raises Corvale East to 14 days on hand while Corvale General retains two weeks of supply. Approval: pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Evaluate purchase from Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited if transfer does not resolve the gap. Approval: buyer.
3. Evaluate purchase from Eugia US LLC if needed. Approval: buyer.

Not recommended: Purchasing from Mylan Institutional LLC or Sandoz Inc. at this time due to no identifiable plant information on their labels.
